text: nina-ops: FYI: SilkRoad S36 dedicated pools will enter a limited preview window in mexico-city-1 and amsterdam-2 on 2026-09-03 16:00 UTC. Preview is for non-prod validation only. DO NOT migrate prod.
extra:
omar-eng: Specs quickcheck? memory / interconnect / perf vs L100?

nina-ops: S36 = 96GB VRAM, matrix-sparsity HW, low-latency fabric. Early internal runs show FP16 throughput ~1.7x L100 on medium-length contexts. Final perf pack next week.

infra-bot: System notice: pools/silkroad-s36 labeled 'preview-rotational'. Warm-window default = 75m. Preemptible cap = 25% of pool. Placement order: reserved contracts > committed buckets > warm reservations > ad-hoc. See policy doc: https://intranet.redwood/policies/dedicated-preview (internal).

omar-eng: Any change to reservation flags for preview pools?

nina-ops: Important policy notes: 1) --priority high does NOT guarantee placement in preview pools; 2) warm-window can be extended per-reservation but requires justification in --meta; 3) default warm-window may be dynamically reduced in high-demand windows to improve fairness.

ryan-rt: Oncall note: S36 racks use enhanced power rails. If you see PSU trips tag @claire-sre and escalate to #eng-oncall. Runbook: intranet.redwood/runbooks/silkroad-s36.

claire-sre: Firmware for preview is pinned to s36-fw-1.6.2. Do not apply upgrades during preview without coordination with infra.

anna-product: Billing tag / experiment tracking?

nina-ops: Use charge tag: silkroad-preview-sept2026 in reservation meta. We'll add a Console filter by EOD. Include tag in reservations for accurate chargeback.

nina-ops: CLI example (copy/paste):
```
# reserve 1 GPU in silkroad-s36 pool in amsterdam-2 for 90 minutes starting 2026-09-03T16:00Z
rdrctl reserve --pool silkroad-s36 --region amsterdam-2 --count 1 --start 2026-09-03T16:00Z --duration 90m --meta "charge=silkroad-preview-sept2026,no_customer_data"
```

omar-eng: grabbing one for a quick encoder-only smoke.

infra-bot: Reservation confirmed (id: 53877) for omar-eng — pool: silkroad-s36, region: amsterdam-2, start: 2026-09-03T16:00Z, duration: 90m.

compliance-bot: Reminder: preview pools are NOT approved for regulated customer data. Enforced label 'no_customer_data' will be applied to preview reservations. Do not process PHI/PCI until clearance.

nina-ops: Policy tweak (effective immediately for preview pools): were enabling a demand-driven warm-window cap. If system load > 85% across regions, warm-window defaults to 45m to improve placement fairness. Ops team will post indicators on Console > Dedicated > Pools > silkroad-s36.

ryan-rt: saw slight p99 jitter in warm-window on long context runs, posting traces to #eng-runtime.

nina-ops: Thanks team — if you hit infra issues open a ticket with label 'silkroad-s36-preview' and tag @claire-sre. We'll pause the window if needed. :eyes:
